        "contents": "const StudioSidebar: React.FC&lt;StudioSidebarProps&gt; = ({\n  outputs = [],\n  conversations = [],\n  onShowConversationList,\n  onTriggerFeature,\n  executingFeatureId,\n  statusMessage,\n  onShowFieldMappingConfig,\n  studioTitle = \"更多工具箱\",\n  featureLabelMap = {},\n  enabledToolIds,\n  pageType,\n  onDeleteConversation,\n}) =&gt; {\n  const navigate = useNavigate();\n  const [selectedConversation, setSelectedConversation] = useState&lt;Conversation | null&gt;(null);\n  const [showDetailModal, setShowDetailModal] = useState(false);\n\n  const formatDaysAgo = (date: Date) =&gt; {\n    const now = new Date();\n    const d = date instanceof Date ? date : new Date(date);\n    const diff = now.getTime() - d.getTime();\n    const days = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));\n    \n    if (days &lt; 1) return \"今天\";\n    if (days &lt; 30) return &#96;${days}天前&#96;;\n    if (days &lt; 365) return &#96;${Math.floor(days / 30)}个月前&#96;;\n    return &#96;${Math.floor(days / 365)}年前&#96;;\n  };\n\n  // 获取对话的首个问题作为标题\n  const getFirstQuestion = (conversation: Conversation): string =&gt; {\n    // 优先从消息中获取首个用户问题\n    if (conversation.messages &amp;&amp; conversation.messages.length &gt; 0) {\n      const firstUserMsg = conversation.messages.find((msg) =&gt; msg.role === \"user\");\n      if (firstUserMsg &amp;&amp; firstUserMsg.content) {\n        // 截取前50个字符作为标题\n        const content = firstUserMsg.content.trim();\n        if (content) {\n          return content.length &gt; 50 ?         "contents": "const CarSeriesList: React.FC&lt;CarSeriesListProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 获取车系列表\n  const fetchCarSeries = async (params?: Partial&lt;CarSeriesSearchParams&gt;) =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(\"\");\n    try {\n      const searchParams: CarSeriesSearchParams = {\n        page: currentPage,\n        pageSize: 20,\n        orderBy: \"created_at\",\n        orderDirection: \"DESC\",\n        includeModel: true,\n        ...params,\n      };\n\n      if (keyword.trim()) {\n        searchParams.keyword = keyword.trim();\n      }\n\n      if (selectedBrandId &gt; 0) {\n        searchParams.brandId = selectedBrandId;\n      }\n\n      if (selectedModelId &gt; 0) {\n        searchParams.modelId = selectedModelId;\n      }\n\n      const response = await carSeriesService.getAll(searchParams);\n\n      if (response.data) {\n        if (Array.isArray(response.data)) {\n          setCarSeries(response.data);\n          setTotalCount(response.data.length);\n        } else {\n          setCarSeries([]);\n          setTotalCount(0);\n        }\n      } else {\n        setCarSeries([]);\n        setTotalCount(0);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"获取车系列表失败:\", error);\n      setError(\"获取车系列表失败，请重试\");\n      setCarSeries([]);\n      setTotalCount(0);\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 获取品牌列表\n  const fetchBrands = async () =&gt;         "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n  const cachedMappingsRef = useRef&lt;any[]&gt;([]);\n\n  // 提取加载工具配置的函数，以便在多个地方调用\n  const loadEnabledToolsForPage = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      console.log('[BaseAISearchPage] 加载工具配置，pageType:', config.pageType);\n      \n      // 1. 优先从字段映射配置中加载（字段映射配置是用户实际配置的，应该优先使用）\n      const mappings = await aiSearchService.getAllFieldMappingConfigs();\n      cachedMappingsRef.current = mappings; // 缓存映射配置\n      \n      // 向后兼容：支持读取旧数据中的 'speech'，但新数据统一使用 'press-release'\n      const pageKeys = config.pageType === 'press-release' \n        ? ['press-release', 'speech'] \n        : [config.pageType];\n      console.log('[BaseAISearchPage] 从字段映射配置加载工具，pageKeys:', pageKeys, 'mappings数量:', mappings.length);\n      \n      const setIds = new Set&lt;string&gt;();\n      const labels: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {};\n      \n      // 从所有字段映射配置中筛选匹配当前 pageType 的工具项\n      // 这样可以聚合所有工作流中配置的该页面的工具\n      for (const item of mappings) {\n        const fos = Array.isArray(item.config?.featureObjects) ? item.config.featureObjects : [];\n        for (const f of fos) {\n          // 排除 ai-dialog，检查是否匹配当前页面的 pageType\n          if (f.featureType &amp;&amp; f.featureType !== 'ai-dialog') {\n            const featurePageType = (f as any).pageType;\n            // 如果 featureObject 有 pageType，必须匹配当前页面；如果没有 pageType，则不显示（避免显示不相关的工具）\n            if (featurePageType &amp;&amp; pageKeys.includes(featurePageType)) {\n              setIds.add(f.featureType);\n              // 如果多个工作流配置了同一个工具，优先使用有 label 的配置\n              if ((f as any).label &amp;&amp; !labels[f.featureType]) {\n                labels[f.featureType] = (f as any).label as string;\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 如果当前工作流有配置，优先使用当前工作流的标签\n  };\n;",

        "contents": "class PublicPageConfigService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 初始化/更新默认页面配置\n   * 确保技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿这3个页面使用正确的模板并处于开启状态\n   * @param templates 模板HTML映射对象，用于获取模板HTML内容\n   */\n  async ensureDefaultPageConfigs(templates?: Record&lt;string, string&gt;): Promise&lt;PublicPageConfig[]&gt; {\n    const existingConfigs = await this.getAllConfigs();\n    const updatedConfigs: PublicPageConfig[] = [];\n\n    // 定义需要确保的3个页面配置\n    const defaultPageConfigs = [\n      {\n        name: '技术包装',\n        description: '技术内容包装工作流公开页面',\n        address: 'tech-package',\n        templateType: 'ai-chat-source-tools' as const,\n      },\n      {\n        name: '技术策略',\n        description: '技术策略生成工作流公开页面',\n        address: 'tech-strategy',\n        templateType: 'ai-chat-source-tools' as const,\n      },\n      {\n        name: '技术通稿',\n        description: '核心内容生成工作流公开页面',\n        address: 'tech-article',\n        templateType: 'ai-chat-source-tools' as const,\n      },\n    ];\n\n    for (const defaultConfig of defaultPageConfigs)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n  const cachedMappingsRef = useRef&lt;any[]&gt;([]);\n\n  // 提取加载工具配置的函数，以便在多个地方调用\n  const loadEnabledToolsForPage = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      console.log('[BaseAISearchPage] 加载工具配置，pageType:', config.pageType);\n      \n      // 1. 优先从字段映射配置中加载（字段映射配置是用户实际配置的，应该优先使用）\n      const mappings = await aiSearchService.getAllFieldMappingConfigs();\n      cachedMappingsRef.current = mappings; // 缓存映射配置\n      \n      // 向后兼容：支持读取旧数据中的 'speech'，但新数据统一使用 'press-release'\n      const pageKeys = config.pageType === 'press-release' \n        ? ['press-release', 'speech'] \n        : [config.pageType];\n      console.log('[BaseAISearchPage] 从字段映射配置加载工具，pageKeys:', pageKeys, 'mappings数量:', mappings.length);\n      \n      const setIds = new Set&lt;string&gt;();\n      const labels: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {};\n      \n      // 从所有字段映射配置中筛选匹配当前 pageType 的工具项\n      // 这样可以聚合所有工作流中配置的该页面的工具\n      for (const item of mappings) {\n        const fos = Array.isArray(item.config?.featureObjects) ? item.config.featureObjects : [];\n        for (const f of fos) {\n          // 排除 ai-dialog，检查是否匹配当前页面的 pageType\n          if (f.featureType &amp;&amp; f.featureType !== 'ai-dialog') {\n            const featurePageType = (f as any).pageType;\n            // 如果 featureObject 有 pageType，必须匹配当前页面；如果没有 pageType，则不显示（避免显示不相关的工具）\n            if (featurePageType &amp;&amp; pageKeys.includes(featurePageType)) {\n              setIds.add(f.featureType);\n              // 如果多个工作流配置了同一个工具，优先使用有 label 的配置\n              if ((f as any).label &amp;&amp; !labels[f.featureType]) {\n                labels[f.featureType] = (f as any).label as string;\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 如果当前工作流有配置，优先使用当前工作流的标签\n  };\n;",

        },
        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n;\n\n  // 监听页面可见性和焦点变化，当页面重新获得焦点时重新加载工具配置\n  // 这样当用户从字段映射管理页面返回时，新添加的工具会自动显示\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    let reloadTimer: number | null = null;\n    \n    const reloadTools = () =&gt; {\n      // 清除之前的定时器\n      if (reloadTimer) {\n        clearTimeout(reloadTimer);\n      }\n      // 延迟一小段时间再加载，避免频繁请求\n      reloadTimer = window.setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n        console.log('[BaseAISearchPage] 页面重新获得焦点，重新加载工具配置');\n        loadEnabledToolsForPage();\n        reloadTimer = null;\n      }, 500);\n    };\n    \n    const handleVisibilityChange = () =&gt; {\n      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') {\n        reloadTools();\n      }\n    };\n\n    const handleFocus = () =&gt; {\n      reloadTools();\n    };\n\n    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);\n    window.addEventListener('focus', handleFocus);\n    \n    return () =&gt; {\n      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);\n      window.removeEventListener('focus', handleFocus);\n      if (reloadTimer) {\n        clearTimeout(reloadTimer);\n      }\n    };\n  }, [loadEnabledToolsForPage]);\n\n  // 只在selectedWorkflowId改变时更新标签（不重新请求API）\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  const reportError = useCallback((message: string, detail?: unknown) =&gt; {\n    setGlobalError(message);\n    if (!detail) {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(null);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (typeof detail === \"string\") {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(detail);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (detail instanceof Error) {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(detail.message);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    try {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(JSON.stringify(detail));\n    } catch {\n      setGlobalErrorDetail(String(detail));\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  const updateTriggerStatus = (message: string | null, duration = 0) =&gt; {\n    if (triggerStatusTimerRef.current) {\n      window.clearTimeout(triggerStatusTimerRef.current);\n      triggerStatusTimerRef.current = null;\n    }\n\n    setTriggeringStatus(message);\n\n    if (message &amp;&amp; duration &gt; 0) {\n      triggerStatusTimerRef.current = window.setTimeout(() =&gt; {\n        setTriggeringStatus(null);\n        triggerStatusTimerRef.current = null;\n      }, duration);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // 获取项目ID和是否创建新对话的标志\n  const projectId = searchParams.get('projectId');\n  const shouldCreateNewConversation = searchParams.get('newConversation') === 'true';\n  \n  // 根据项目ID调整 pageType，确保不同项目的对话相互独立\n  // 项目隔离规则：\n  // - 非关联项目（无 projectId）：使用默认 pageType（如 tech-package、tech-strategy、tech-article）\n  // - 关联项目（有 projectId）：使用 pageType-project-{projectId}（如 tech-package-project-3）\n  // 这样确保不同项目下的技术包装、技术策略、技术通稿的对话、记录、来源信息等都保持独立\n  const effectivePageType = useMemo(() =&gt; {\n    if (projectId) {\n      // 如果有项目ID，使用项目特定的 pageType，例如：tech-package-project-3\n      return &#96;${config.pageType}-project-${projectId}&#96;;\n    }\n    // 无项目ID时，使用默认 pageType，对应\"非关联项目\"\n    return config.pageType;\n  }, [config.pageType, projectId]);\n\n  // 加载页面类型的来源信息（作为基础来源，始终保留）\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 加载页面类型的来源信息（作为基础来源，始终保留）\n  const loadPageTypeSources = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 使用有效的 pageType（可能包含项目ID），确保项目隔离\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 开始加载页面类型来源信息:', effectivePageType);\n      const sourceResult = await sourceService.loadSourceInformationByPageType(effectivePageType);\n      console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载结果:', {\n        success: sourceResult.success,\n        count: sourceResult.data?.length || 0,\n        error: sourceResult.error\n      });\n      \n      if (sourceResult.success &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data &amp;&amp; sourceResult.data.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 加载到的来源:', sourceResult.data.map(s =&gt; ({ id: s.id, title: s.title })));\n        setSources(prev =&gt; {\n          // 只保留文件来源（file_开头的），然后添加当前页面的来源\n          // 这样可以确保切换页面时只显示当前页面的来源\n          const fileSources = prev.filter(s =&gt; s.id.startsWith('file_'));\n          const pageTypeSources = sourceResult.data!;\n          \n          // 合并文件来源和页面类型来源\n          const sourceMap = new Map&lt;string, Source&gt;();\n          fileSources.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n          pageTypeSources.forEach(s =&gt; sourceMap.set(s.id, s));\n          \n          const merged = Array.from(sourceMap.values());\n          console.log('[SourceInfo] 合并后的来源数量:', merged.length, {\n            fileSources: fileSources.length,\n            pageTypeSources: pageTypeSources.length\n          });\n          return merged;\n        });\n      } else if (sourceResult.error) {\n        console.warn('[SourceInfo] 加载失败:', sourceResult.error);\n        // 即使加载失败，也要清除其他页面的来源，只保留文件来源\n  };\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadConversationDetail = \nasync (\n      conversationId: string,\n      options?: {\n        append?: boolean;\n        before?: string;\n      }\n    ) =&gt; {\n\n      }\n    },\n    [reportError]\n  );\n\n  const loadConversations = useCallback(async (options?: { refreshActive?: boolean; activeConversationId?: string }) =&gt; {\n    // 使用有效的 pageType（可能包含项目ID）\n    try {\n      const data = await aiSearchService.getConversations(effectivePageType);\n      console.log('[ConversationDebug] 加载对话列表，原始数据:', data.length, '条对话');\n      \n      // 按ID去重，保留最新的对话（按updated_at排序）\n      const conversationMap = new Map&lt;string, Conversation&gt;();\n      const duplicateIds: string[] = [];\n      data.forEach((conv) =&gt; {\n        const existing = conversationMap.get(conv.id);\n        if (!existing) {\n          conversationMap.set(conv.id, conv);\n        } else {\n          duplicateIds.push(conv.id);\n          // 如果已存在，比较更新时间，保留更新的\n          const existingTime = existing.updatedAt instanceof Date \n            ? existing.updatedAt.getTime() \n            : new Date(existing.updatedAt).getTime();\n          const currentTime = conv.updatedAt instanceof Date \n            ? conv.updatedAt.getTime() \n            : new Date(conv.updatedAt).getTime();\n          if (currentTime &gt; existingTime) {\n            conversationMap.set(conv.id, conv);\n          }\n        }\n      });\n      \n      if (duplicateIds.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.warn('[ConversationDebug] 发现重复的对话ID:', duplicateIds);\n      }\n      \n      // 转换为数组并按更新时间排序\n      const uniqueConversations = Array.from(conversationMap.values()).sort((a, b) =&gt; {\n        const timeA = a.updatedAt instanceof Date ? a.updatedAt.getTime() : new Date(a.updatedAt).getTime();\n        const timeB = b.updatedAt instanceof Date ? b.updatedAt.getTime() : new Date(b.updatedAt).getTime();\n        return timeB - timeA; // 降序排列，最新的在前\n      });\n      \n      console.log('[ConversationDebug] 去重后的对话列表:', uniqueConversations.length, '条对话，IDs:', uniqueConversations.map(c =&gt; c.id));\n      setConversations(uniqueConversations);\n\n      if (uniqueConversations.length === 0)\n  };\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadingConversationRef = &lt;Set&lt;string&gt;&gt;(new Set());\n  \n  const loadConversationDetail = useCallback(\n    async (\n      conversationId: string,\n      options?: {\n        append?: boolean;\n        before?: string;\n      }\n    ) =&gt; {\n      if (!conversationId) return;\n      \n      // 如果正在加载同一个对话，且不是追加模式，则跳过\n      if (!options?.append &amp;&amp; loadingConversationRef.current.has(conversationId)) {\n        console.log('[SourceInfo] 跳过重复加载对话:', conversationId);\n        return;\n      }\n      \n      // 标记为正在加载\n      loadingConversationRef.current.add(conversationId);\n      \n      try {\n        const detail = await aiSearchService.getConversation(conversationId, {\n          limit: MESSAGE_PAGE_SIZE,\n          before: options?.before,\n        });\n        if (!detail) {\n          return;\n        }\n        \n        // 从数据库加载该对话的来源信息（仅在非追加模式下加载，避免重复）\n    }\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const MultiChatContainer: React.FC&lt;MultiChatContainerProps&gt; = \n\n\n  // 从localStorage加载配置\n  const loadConfig = () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      const configStr = localStorage.getItem('multiChatWorkflowConfig');\n      if (configStr) {\n        const config = JSON.parse(configStr);\n        setSelectedWorkflowId(config.workflowId || '');\n        setSelectedRoleIds(config.roleIds || []);\n        setDisplayMode(config.displayMode || 'all');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('加载配置失败:', error);\n    }\n  };\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    if (embedded &amp;&amp; initialWorkflowId) {\n      setSelectedWorkflowId(initialWorkflowId);\n      setDisplayMode('workflow');\n    }\n  }, [embedded, initialWorkflowId]);\n\n  // 当配置或所有角色变化时，更新显示的角色\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    let filteredRoles: AIRoleConfig[] = [];\n\n    if (displayMode === 'all') {\n      // 显示所有启用的角色\n      filteredRoles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; r.enabled);\n    } else if (displayMode === 'workflow' &amp;&amp; selectedWorkflowId) {\n      // 从工作流中提取角色\n      const workflow = workflows.find(w =&gt; w.id === selectedWorkflowId);\n      if (workflow &amp;&amp; workflow.nodes) {\n        const workflowAgentIds = workflow.nodes\n          .flatMap(node =&gt; extractAgentIdsFromNode(node))\n          .filter(Boolean);\n        const uniqueAgentIds = Array.from(new Set(workflowAgentIds));\n        filteredRoles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; \n          r.enabled &amp;&amp; uniqueAgentIds.includes(r.id)\n        );\n      }\n    } else if (displayMode === 'custom' &amp;&amp; selectedRoleIds.length &gt; 0) {\n      // 只显示选定的角色\n      filteredRoles = allRoles.filter(r =&gt; \n        r.enabled &amp;&amp; selectedRoleIds.includes(r.id)\n      );\n    }\n\n    setRoles(filteredRoles);\n  }, [allRoles, displayMode, selectedWorkflowId, selectedRoleIds, workflows]);\n  \n  // 加载工作流列表\n  const loadWorkflows = async () =&gt;\n;\n;",

['press-release', 'speech'] \n        : [config.pageType];\n      \n      const currentMapping = mappings.find(m =&gt; m.workflowId === selectedWorkflowId);\n      if (currentMapping) {\n        const labels: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {};\n        const fos = Array.isArray(currentMapping.config?.featureObjects) ? currentMapping.config.featureObjects : [];\n        \n        for (const f of fos) {\n          if (f.featureType &amp;&amp; f.featureType !== 'ai-dialog') {\n            const featurePageType = (f as any).pageType;\n            if (featurePageType &amp;&amp; pageKeys.includes(featurePageType)) {\n              if ((f as any).label) {\n                labels[f.featureType] = (f as any).label as string;\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 只有在找到标签时才更新\n        if (Object.keys(labels).length &gt; 0) {\n          setDynamicLabelMap(prev =&gt; ({ ...prev, ...labels }));\n        }\n      }\n    };\n\n    updateLabelsForWorkflow();\n  }, [selectedWorkflowId, config.pageType]);\n\n  const handleWorkflowSelectionChange = useCallback(\n    (workflowId: string) =&gt; {\n      if (!workflowId) return;\n      setSelectedWorkflowId(workflowId);\n      persistWorkflowSelection(workflowId, currentConversation?.id);\n    },\n    [currentConversation?.id, persistWorkflowSelection]\n  );\n\n  // 从字段映射配置中获取该 pageType 的默认工作流\n  const [defaultWorkflowFromMapping, setDefaultWorkflowFromMapping] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadDefaultWorkflowFromMapping = async ()\n;\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \n\n  const cachedMappingsRef = useRef&lt;any[]&gt;([]);\n\n  // 提取加载工具配置的函数，以便在多个地方调用\n  const loadEnabledToolsForPage = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      console.log('[BaseAISearchPage] 加载工具配置，pageType:', config.pageType);\n      \n      // 1. 优先从字段映射配置中加载（字段映射配置是用户实际配置的，应该优先使用）\n      const mappings = await aiSearchService.getAllFieldMappingConfigs();\n      cachedMappingsRef.current = mappings; // 缓存映射配置\n      \n      // 向后兼容：支持读取旧数据中的 'speech'，但新数据统一使用 'press-release'\n      const pageKeys = config.pageType === 'press-release' \n        ? ['press-release', 'speech'] \n        : [config.pageType];\n      console.log('[BaseAISearchPage] 从字段映射配置加载工具，pageKeys:', pageKeys, 'mappings数量:', mappings.length);\n      \n      const setIds = new Set&lt;string&gt;();\n      const labels: Record&lt;string, string&gt; = {};\n      \n      // 从所有字段映射配置中筛选匹配当前 pageType 的工具项\n      // 这样可以聚合所有工作流中配置的该页面的工具\n      for (const item of mappings) {\n        const fos = Array.isArray(item.config?.featureObjects) ? item.config.featureObjects : [];\n        for (const f of fos) {\n          // 排除 ai-dialog，检查是否匹配当前页面的 pageType\n          if (f.featureType &amp;&amp; f.featureType !== 'ai-dialog') {\n            const featurePageType = (f as any).pageType;\n            // 如果 featureObject 有 pageType，必须匹配当前页面；如果没有 pageType，则不显示（避免显示不相关的工具）\n            if (featurePageType &amp;&amp; pageKeys.includes(featurePageType)) {\n              setIds.add(f.featureType);\n              // 如果多个工作流配置了同一个工具，优先使用有 label 的配置\n              if ((f as any).label &amp;&amp; !labels[f.featureType]) {\n                labels[f.featureType] = (f as any).label as string;\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 如果当前工作流有配置，优先使用当前工作流的标签\n  };\n;",

['press-release', 'speech'] \n          : [config.pageType];\n        \n        for (const mapping of mappings) {\n          const featureObjects = Array.isArray(mapping.config?.featureObjects) \n            ? mapping.config.featureObjects \n            : [];\n          \n          // 查找第一个匹配当前 pageType 的 featureObject，使用其 workflowId 作为默认工作流\n          const matchedFeature = featureObjects.find((f: any) =&gt; \n            f.pageType &amp;&amp; pageKeys.includes(f.pageType)\n          );\n          \n          if (matchedFeature) {\n            const workflowId = matchedFeature.workflowId || mapping.workflowId;\n            // 验证工作流是否在可用列表中\n            if (availableWorkflows.some(w =&gt; w.id === workflowId)) {\n              setDefaultWorkflowFromMapping(workflowId);\n              console.log(&#96;[BaseAISearchPage] 从字段映射配置找到 ${config.pageType} 的默认工作流:&#96;, workflowId);\n              return;\n            }\n          }\n        }\n        \n        // 如果没有找到匹配的，尝试使用该工作流配置中的第一个工作流\n        // 查找所有为该 pageType 配置的工作流，使用第一个\n        const allWorkflowsForPage = new Set&lt;string&gt;();\n        for (const mapping of mappings) {\n          const featureObjects = Array.isArray(mapping.config?.featureObjects)\n;\n;\n  }\n;",

        "contents": "const BaseAISearchPage: React.FC&lt;BaseAISearchPageProps&gt; = \nconst loadEnabledToolsForPage = async () =&gt; {\n\n      \n      // 如果当前工作流有配置，优先使用当前工作流的标签\n      if (selectedWorkflowId) {\n        const currentMapping = mappings.find(m =&gt; m.workflowId === selectedWorkflowId);\n        if (currentMapping) {\n          const fos = Array.isArray(currentMapping.config?.featureObjects) ? currentMapping.config.featureObjects : [];\n          for (const f of fos) {\n            if (f.featureType &amp;&amp; f.featureType !== 'ai-dialog') {\n              const featurePageType = (f as any).pageType;\n              if (featurePageType &amp;&amp; pageKeys.includes(featurePageType)) {\n                if ((f as any).label) {\n                  labels[f.featureType] = (f as any).label as string;\n                }\n              }\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      \n      console.log('[BaseAISearchPage] 从字段映射配置找到的工具数量:', setIds.size, '工具列表:', Array.from(setIds));\n      \n      // 如果字段映射配置中有工具，优先使用字段映射配置\n      if (setIds.size &gt; 0) {\n        const toolIds = Array.from(setIds);\n        setEnabledToolIds(toolIds);\n        setDynamicLabelMap(labels);\n        // 缓存工具ID\n        cachedToolIdsRef.current[config.pageType] = toolIds;\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // 2. 如果字段映射配置中没有工具，尝试从数据库加载页面工具配置\n      const dbConfig = await pageToolConfigService.getByPageType(config.pageType);\n      if (dbConfig &amp;&amp; dbConfig.enabledToolIds &amp;&amp; dbConfig.enabledToolIds.length &gt; 0) {\n        console.log('[BaseAISearchPage] 字段映射配置为空，从数据库配置加载工具:', dbConfig.enabledToolIds);\n        setEnabledToolIds(dbConfig.enabledToolIds);\n        setDynamicLabelMap(dbConfig.featureLabelMap || {});\n        // 缓存工具ID\n        cachedToolIdsRef.current[config.pageType] = dbConfig.enabledToolIds;\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // 3. 如果都没有，回退到使用配置中的默认工具列表\n  };\n;",

        "contents": "class AiSearchService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * 获取配置的工作流\n   */\n  async getWorkflowConfig(pageType?: 'tech-package' | 'press-release' | 'tech-strategy' | 'tech-article'): Promise&lt;WorkflowConfig | null&gt; {\n    try {\n      // 先尝试从API获取配置的工作流ID，传递pageType参数\n      const params = pageType ? &#96;?pageType=${pageType}&#96; : '';\n      const response = await api.get(&#96;/ai-search/workflow${params}&#96;);\n      if (response.data.success &amp;&amp; response.data.data) {\n        const workflowId = response.data.data.workflowId;\n        // 获取工作流详情\n        const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\n        const workflow = workflows.find((w) =&gt; w.id === workflowId);\n        if (workflow) {\n          return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // 如果没有配置，尝试查找默认工作流（根据页面类型）\n      const workflows = await agentWorkflowService.getAllWorkflows();\n      const defaultWorkflowName = pageType === 'press-release' ? '发布会稿工作流' : '智能工作流';\n      const defaultWorkflow = workflows.find((w) =&gt; w.name === defaultWorkflowName);\n      if (defaultWorkflow) {\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(defaultWorkflow);\n      }\n      \n      // 返回第一个工作流\n      if (workflows.length &gt; 0) {\n        return this.convertWorkflowToConfig(workflows[0]);\n      }\n      \n      return null;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('获取工作流配置失败:', error);\n      return null;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 转换工作流为配置格式\n   */\n  private convertWorkflowToConfig(workflow: any): WorkflowConfig {\n    // 从工作流的输入节点和输出节点提取参数\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes.find((n: any) =&gt; n.type === 'input');\n  }",

        "contents": "import { logger } from '@/shared/lib/logger';\nimport { Result, failure, success } from '@/shared/lib/result';\n\nexport class GetAllFieldMappingConfigsUseCase {\n  constructor(private readonly fieldMappingService: FieldMappingService) {}\n\n  async execute(): Promise&lt;Result&lt;any[]&gt;&gt; {\n    try {\n      const configs = await this.fieldMappingService.getAllFieldMappingConfigs();\n      return success(configs);\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('获取所有字段映射配置失败', { error });\n      return failure({\n        code: 'GET_ALL_FIELD_MAPPINGS_FAILED',\n        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : '获取所有字段映射配置失败',\n        details: error,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}",

{\n    const inputNode = workflow.nodes?.find((n: any) =&gt; n.type === 'input');\n    const outputNode = workflow.nodes?.find((n: any) =&gt; n.type === 'output');\n    \n    const inputParameters = inputNode?.data?.inputs || [];\n    const outputParameters = outputNode?.data?.outputs || [];\n    \n    return {\n      id: workflow.id,\n      name: workflow.name,\n      description: workflow.description,\n      inputParameters: inputParameters.map((p: any) =&gt; ({\n        name: p.name,\n        type: p.type || 'string',\n        required: p.required || false,\n        description: p.description,\n      })),\n      outputParameters: outputParameters.map((p: any) =&gt; AND is_active = 1\n        LIMIT 1\n      &#96;;\n    } else {\n      sql = &#96;\n        SELECT * FROM page_tool_configs\n        WHERE page_type = $1 AND is_active = 1\n        LIMIT 1\n      &#96;;\n    }\n\n    const params = dbType === 'sqlite' ? 问题：`loadEnabledToolsForPage` 每次都会调用 API，即使已有缓存，导致组件需等待 API 响应才能显示工具项。

优化：优先使用缓存或默认值立即显示，然后在后台更新。
